name: old_map_north
description: Antique 'Carta Marina'-style map of the north (inspired, not copied): parchment #e9dcc0 sheet with torn edges and age stains, brown-ink #5a3a1e coastlines of Scandinavia, Finland, Denmark and the Baltic, wavy sea hatching, little ink mountains and trees, a compass rose (red north point) in the North Sea, a tiny sea serpent and a little sailing ship in the Norwegian Sea, double border. No text. Centre anchor, ~900x620 (x -450..450, y -310..310). Clear land patch around (+135,-40) (northern Sweden) for a small wolverine_bloated.
